## Activity

During July 2026, East City Eye Clinic recorded 192 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity provides the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading outcomes. All results in this report relate to the captures recorded at the site during July 2026.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 1.6. These captures could not proceed through grading because the available images did not meet the requirements for assessment. The rate is reported against the total capture activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 50 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This measure summarises the time taken for results to move from image capture to grading during the reporting period. Together, the grading results and the image-quality findings provide a summary of activity and reporting performance at East City Eye Clinic for July 2026.
